newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bond futures edge to new session high late.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bond futures edge to new session high late.

text.p: July 1 - September Treasury bond futures inched to a new high for the session at 111-29 in the final hour of trade as a combination of short-covering and pre-FOMC speculative interest continued to lift prices, traders said. FOMC concludes its two-day session Wednesday. Treasury prices hitting resistance near 6.75 percent cash bond yield. (Chicago Derivatives Desk (312)408-8750))
